roll_call: I am François Pinault. I began as a timber merchant in Brittany and kept changing my own course.
I work, observe, and then take risks. The rule is the same in business and collecting.
The work that will bring me the greatest joy is still out there. I will keep looking today.
deploy: Once you have finished observing, move first. Without risk, there is no new market.
Do not erase the past. Build something radically new within it.
Open your mind and see differently. Art is the best medicine.
battle_win: Once again, I did not miss the moment to change course.
Now the work I could not let escape can be shared with many more people.
The old and the boldness of the twenty-first century have finally found harmony.
battle_draw: At first, this circle within a circle surprised me. I will think once more before I judge.
Not every work moves me. I will keep looking until I find the exception.
A collection is never complete. Its most beautiful work is still out there.
battle_lose: This choice missed its mark. I will observe again and change course.
This work did not seize me. I will not pretend to be moved.
Today's failure will not prevent tomorrow's most beautiful discovery.
clash_attack: Once you have finished observing, move first!
This is a work we cannot let escape. Seize it now!
Do not destroy the past. Build the twenty-first century within it!
